verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's docs say each AI agent gets an isolated cloud computer to run code, rather than a cloud VM, VPS or developer workstation. They also document outbound network policy, credential injection that keeps raw secrets out of the sandbox process, and a signed audit ledger, which together cover the core of running untrusted code away from your own infrastructure. missing for 10: documentation of the actual isolation boundary (e.g., microVM/kernel-level isolation guarantees), independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation claims.
